cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Could you co-sign the form for borrowing this barbecue?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll help carry it. That handle looks cracked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Good eye. Sign as joint custodian; we'll inspect it together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner wants a replacement by Sunday if it breaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're co-chair of replacements too. I'll call the shops; you approve what we buy before either of us promises her anything.

mechanism: A corrects a helper's limited carrying offer into official shared custody, then supervises shared replacement responsibility.
confusable: Delegating chores alone misses D169; B must become an official participant liable for the outcome.
comparison: Borrowed-property risk differs from a volunteer driver becoming an accountable trip organizer.
seedUse: Keep cracked handle and replacement deadline, with precise inspection and agreement corrections rather than a generic standard.
